reason: A client plugin that adapts the DSH web shell for phone-sized viewports by adding overlay panels and responsive composer and settings layouts while leaving desktop behavior unchanged.

summaries.zh: 为DSH网页外壳提供手机端适配，将侧边栏和详情面板改为浮层，并优化输入栏与设置页的响应式布局。
summaries.en: A mobile adapter for the DSH web shell that provides overlay panels and responsive layouts for the composer and settings interface on phone-sized screens.

capabilities: Modifies client-side responsive layout for narrow viewports
Converts sidebar and details panels into mobile overlays
Reflows composer and settings dialog for phone-sized screens
